source: Finally, category A elements provide a striking illustration of the physical segregation of H3K9me3 and H3K27me3: as H3K9me3 constitutively marks the 5' end of this transposon category, only their 3' end is accessible to H3K27me3 deposition upon DNA methylation loss.
evidence: This is based on ChIP-seq metaplot data analysis.

claim: The presence of H3K27me3 at the 3' end of transcription units has not been described before.
source: The presence of H3K27me3 at the 3' end of transcription units has not been described before and its functional significance was unknown.
evidence: This is stated as a novel observation from the study.

claim: 3' end enrichment of H3K27me3 does not confer transcriptional repression of transposons of the A category.
source: Our transcriptome analysis of 2i+vitC-converted Eed-KO cells reveals that 3' end enrichment of H3K27me3 does not confer transcriptional repression of transposons of the A category: it may rather represent a passive response to the lack of DNA methylation and H3K9me3 at this position.
evidence: This is inferred from the RNA-seq data in Eed-KO cells.

claim: 3' end H3K27me3 may represent a passive response to the lack of DNA methylation and H3K9me3 at this position.
source: Our transcriptome analysis of 2i+vitC-converted Eed-KO cells reveals that 3' end enrichment of H3K27me3 does not confer transcriptional repression of transposons of the A category: it may rather represent a passive response to the lack of DNA methylation and H3K9me3 at this position.
evidence: This is speculative reasoning based on the functional data.

claim: Compensatory histone-based mechanisms ensure transposon silencing when DNA methylation-based control is alleviated in ES cells.
source: The main message conveyed by our work is that compensatory histone-based mechanisms ensure transposon silencing when DNA methylation-based control is alleviated in ES cells.
evidence: This is a summary conclusion based on the study findings.

claim: The epigenetic switch from a DNA methylation-dependent to -independent mode of transposon silencing is not perfectly synchronized.
source: Finally, one important point to raise is that the epigenetic switch from a DNA methylation-dependent to -independent mode of transposon silencing is not perfectly synchronized: ES cells experience an acute burst of transposon expression at D6 of medium conversion.
evidence: This is based on the temporal analysis of DNA methylation, chromatin, and expression data.

claim: At D6 of medium conversion, DNA methylation has been mostly erased but H3K27me3 patterns have not been established yet.
source: At this time point, we showed that DNA methylation has been mostly erased but H3K27me3 patterns have not been established yet.
evidence: This is based on WGBS and ChIP-seq data analysis.

claim: The stability of H3K9me3 marks at category A and B transposons is not sufficient to ensure their continuous silencing upon conversion.
source: Interestingly, the stability of H3K9me3 marks at category A and B transposons is not sufficient to ensure their continuous silencing upon conversion.
evidence: This is inferred from the observation of transposon expression at D6 despite H3K9me3 presence.

claim: H3K9me3 readers may be transiently deficient during serum to 2i+vitC conversion.
source: This may imply that H3K9me3 readers are transiently deficient in this system.
evidence: This is speculative reasoning to explain the transient de-repression.

claim: The lag between DNA methylation loss and subsequent implementation of histone-based repression could create an opportunistic window for transposon reactivation, provided that adequate transcription factors are available.
source: The lag between DNA methylation loss and subsequent implementation of histone-based repression could create an opportunistic window for transposon reactivation, provided that adequate transcription factors are available.
evidence: This is speculative reasoning based on the temporal dynamics observed.

claim: Transposons are enriched in pluripotency transcription factor binding motifs, in particular for NANOG and OCT4.
source: Several studies have previously pointed out that transposons are enriched in pluripotency transcription factor binding motifs (Kunarso et al., 2010; Wang et al., 2014), in particular for NANOG and OCT4, and that upregulation of these transcription factors was sufficient to promote transposon expression (Grow et al., 2015).
evidence: The claim is supported by citations to Kunarso et al., 2010, Wang et al., 2014, and Grow et al., 2015.

claim: Upregulation of pluripotency transcription factors was sufficient to promote transposon expression.
source: Several studies have previously pointed out that transposons are enriched in pluripotency transcription factor binding motifs (Kunarso et al., 2010; Wang et al., 2014), in particular for NANOG and OCT4, and that upregulation of these transcription factors was sufficient to promote transposon expression (Grow et al., 2015).
evidence: The claim is supported by a citation to Grow et al., 2015.

claim: The simultaneous disappearance of DNA methylation marks and increased availability of pluripotency activators create favorable conditions to transposon expression at D6 of serum to 2i+vitC conversion.
source: We propose that the simultaneous disappearance of DNA methylation marks and increased availability of pluripotency activators create favorable conditions to transposon expression at D6 of serum to 2i+vitC conversion (Figure 8B).
evidence: This is a proposed model based on the study findings, illustrated in Figure 8B.

claim: After a brief silencing release, functional repressive chromatin is recovered, in an H3K9me3 and/or H3K27me3-dependent manner.
source: After a brief silencing release, functional repressive chromatin is recovered, in an H3K9me3 and/or H3K27me3-dependent manner.
evidence: This is a summary of the study findings.

claim: A peak of massive cell death of H3K27me3-deficient Eed-KO ES cells was observed between D6 and D10 of medium conversion, when DNA methylation has mostly disappeared.
source: Notably, we repeatedly observed a peak of massive cell death of H3K27me3-deficient Eed-KO ES cells between D6 and D10 of medium conversion, when DNA methylation has mostly disappeared.
evidence: This is based on observations during cell culture experiments.

claim: The cell death phenotype in Eed-KO cells was exacerbated in Suv39h-Eed-tKO ES cells, which did not survive after a week of medium conversion.
source: This phenotype was even exacerbated in Suv39h-Eed-tKO ES cells, which did not survive after a week of medium conversion.
evidence: This is based on observations during cell culture experiments.

claim: H3K27me3 plays a critical role in supplementing DNA methylation-based control in ES cells.
source: These observations support the critical role for H3K27me3 in supplementing DNA methylation-based control in ES cells.
evidence: This is inferred from the cell death phenotypes in Eed-KO and Suv39h-Eed-tKO cells.
